description: This file manages Nextcloud Talk account configurations, including listing accounts, resolving account details, secrets, and enabling status within a larger application.

classes.name: ResolvedNextcloudTalkAccount
classes.description: Type defining the structure of a resolved Nextcloud Talk account, including account ID, enabled status, URL, secret, and configuration.

methods.name: listNextcloudTalkAccountIds
methods.description: Returns a list of Nextcloud Talk account IDs from the configuration.

methods.name: resolveNextcloudTalkAccount
methods.description: Resolves detailed information for a specific Nextcloud Talk account, including secret and enabled status.

methods.name: listEnabledNextcloudTalkAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of all enabled Nextcloud Talk accounts with their details.
